value.data: A 7.3-acre luxury development with large-hearted 3 and 4 bed residences. It features a 50,000 sq. ft. clubhouse and 80% open spaces, offering unparalleled views of the cityscape and Amruthahalli lake.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally appreciate Century Ethos for its luxurious apartments, extensive amenities, and prime location, often considering it a strong investment. However, some concerns are raised regarding construction quality issues, high maintenance costs, and external traffic congestion.
